biotools.summary: Fluid-Squid is an open-source, cost-effective platform for automated fluidics and microscopy that supports customizable, multiplexed imaging workflows. It enables imaging of cells and tissues with multiplexed antibody panels, demonstrating feasibility in characterizing immune cell populations and antigen-specific cells.
